title: Silver Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document explains Silver Saver Account mobile banking limits: mobile check deposits are capped at $5,000 per day, and outbound transfers from mobile/online are capped at $10,000 per day (multiple transfers aggregate). It also provides tips if a transfer/deposit would exceed the cap, including splitting deposits across multiple days and scheduling on consecutive business days or earlier in the day, and contacting support if caps are regularly exceeded.
